content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Cornwall Police Service's PostCornwall Police Service5d · Shared with Public#545 - Happy Nowruz!Celebrated on the first day of spring, Nowruz marks the Persian New Year and has been observed for more than 3,000 years across many cultures in the Middle East, Central Asia and beyond.The word Nowruz means “new day,” and the celebration symbolizes renewal, hope and the arrival of spring. Families gather around the traditional Haft-Seen table, share meals, visit loved ones and welcome the year ahead with wishes for health and prosperity.Celebrations like Nowruz remind us how the traditions people carry with them help strengthen connection, understanding, and belonging within our community.To everyone celebrating - Nowruz Mobarak!
